articles.title: Jharkhand Failed To Submit Utilisation Certificates For Rs 1.33 Lakh Crore Grants: CAG Report
articles.description: The Comptroller and Auditor General has said that the Jharkhand government failed to submit utilisation certificates for grants totalling Rs 1.33 lakh crore, and directed the administration to initiate action against those responsible for the default.
articles.content: Audit observed that 47,367 utilisation certificates, due in respect of grants aggregating Rs 1,33,161.50 crore, paid up to fiscal 2022-23, were outstanding at the end of March 2024,' the report said.
